KXCOPPAITALIA.note: No rules sampled; multi-round domestic cup trophy, so the competition winner bracket mechanism fits. Low confidence is honest.

KXCOUPEDEFRANCE.note: No rules sampled; multi-round knockout cup champion, generated by bracket progression and team strength, as competition_winner_and_top_n models.

KXEPLADVANCE.note: No rules; a league has no ties, so these are likely cup or playoff ties under a league prefix. Advancement is the only coherent mechanism; an 'unknown' archetype is not a mechanism.

KXEPLPOY.note: No rules sampled; a Player of the Year honour is decided by a vote or panel, which player_award models. Voting body unverified, low confidence kept.

KXEPLTOTAL.note: Rules confirm a single-match over N.5 goals ladder after 90 minutes plus stoppage, excluding extra time; total_goals is correct and the aggregate proposal is refuted.

KXGERSCGAME.note: No rules; KX*GAME soccer series sampled elsewhere are 90-minute 3-way results, so a single DFL-Supercup match plausibly follows that template. Low confidence kept.

KXINTLFRIENDLYFGW.note: Rules: player scores first non-own goal AND his team wins incl. extra time. First-goalscorer is a listed contract type of player_goal_assist_props; single series, no new archetype warranted.

KXITASUPERCUPADVANCE.note: OVERRIDE: the ADVANCE ticker and the four-team Supercoppa knockout format point to per-tie advancement contracts (ET/penalties decide), not an outright winner of a season competition.

KXLIGUE1ADVANCE.note: Same as KXEPLADVANCE: no rules, league has no ties; advancement from a tie is the only mechanism consistent with the ticker. Low confidence retained.

KXMENWORLDCUP.note: No rules; World Cup champion is generated by group stage plus 32-team knockout bracket and team strength, exactly competition_winner_and_top_n.

KXMLSSKILLS.note: No rules; a skills competition is soccer performance but not a match or season outcome. Single series, so filing in the specials catch-all is acceptable.

KXMWORLDCUP.note: Duplicate ticker of the World Cup winner market; no rules sampled. Bracket-and-strength outright mechanism, competition_winner_and_top_n is right.

KXPLAYWC.note: No rules; most likely whether a named player appears at the World Cup (squad selection plus fitness). Only one or two such series, so the specials catch-all is tolerable.

KXSERIEAADVANCE.note: Same as other league ADVANCE series: no rules, no league ties, advancement from a cup or playoff tie is the only coherent reading; low confidence.

KXSOCCERBTTS.note: No rules but the title names the mechanism (both teams score); btts_and_clean_sheet is correct and the ledger's correct-score filing was wrong.

KXSUPERBALLONDOR.note: Rules: YES if anyone is awarded a Super Ballon d'Or before 2030. This is whether the organiser creates and confers the one-off honour, an official decision, not a vote among candidates.

KXT20WORLDCUP.note: Cricket T20 World Cup; outcome is decided by cricket, an unsupported sport, so OUT_OF_SCOPE:other_sport_cricket is correct despite no rules text.

KXUCL1HBTTS.note: Rules: both teams score in the 1st Half only; the btts archetype target explicitly includes the first-half variant, so it stays rather than moving to period markets.

KXUCLACOACH.note: UCLA is a US college program (most likely football/basketball coaching), not the Champions League; out of scope for SOCCER. Should be cross-referenced to CFB/CBB off-field.

KXUEFASUPERCUP.note: No rules; a one-match final, but Kalshi 'Winner' series (e.g. KXCOPADELREY) settle on who is champion, which competition_winner_and_top_n covers incl. a final's ET/shootout.

KXWC1STTIMEWIN.note: No rules; whether the champion is a first-time winner is a partition of the outright winner distribution, generated by the same bracket mechanism.

KXWCAWARD.note: No rules; World Cup awards (Golden Ball voted by FIFA technical group; Golden Boot is stat-based). player_award fits most variants; mixture noted, low confidence.

KXWCAWARDCOMBO.note: No rules; combination of World Cup award winners, mostly panel-decided, so player_award; stat-based Golden Boot leg is a known caveat.

KXWCCONCEDE1ST.note: No rules; title is ambiguous (tournament-level concede-first event vs single-match complement of team-to-score-first). Aggregate reading accepted at low confidence.

KXWCEVERYTEAMGOAL.note: No rules; every one of 48 teams scoring at least once is a joint event over all group matches, a tournament aggregate no single-match archetype generates.

KXWCFIFATOP10.note: No rules; the title could instead mean whether a FIFA top-10 team wins; the ranking-formula reading is kept at low confidence and this ambiguity should stay open.

KXWCFTTS.note: No rules; title and sibling FTTS series (rules: first goal incl. extra time) indicate single-match first-team-to-score; correct archetype.

KXWCGAMEGOALS.note: No rules; highest-scoring game is the maximum of match goal totals across the tournament, an extreme-value aggregate distinct from a single-match ladder.

KXWCGROUPWINELIM.note: No rules; group winners losing in the round of 32 is generated by group finishes and knockout ties, i.e. the advancement mechanism (counted over ties).

KXWCGROUPWINNER.note: No rules; whether read as which group produces the champion or a team topping its group, it is a winner/top-N finish outcome. Agree, low.

KXWCGSGOALS.note: No rules; total goals across the 72 group-stage matches is a sum over many matches, fits tournament_aggregate_event_props (family of 9 shares the mechanism).

KXWCHOSTKO.note: No rules; all three hosts reaching the knockouts is a joint group-advancement event, generated by the advancement mechanism, not an announcement.

KXWCHOSTSTAGE.note: No rules; furthest stage reached by any host is the maximum over host advancement paths; relegation_qualification_advancement mechanism generates it.

KXWCHOSTWIN.note: No rules; host nation winning the World Cup is a subset of the outright winner distribution; competition_winner_and_top_n is right.

KXWCKOPENALTIES.note: No rules; count of knockout matches going to penalties is a sum of per-tie draw-after-ET events, a tournament aggregate. Agree.

KXWCLOCATION.note: No rules; a match venue follows from bracket slot via the fixed schedule. Overlaps advancement, but slot-to-venue mapping justifies the composition archetype.

KXWCLONGESTPEN.note: No rules; longest shootout is an extreme over shootouts, depends on shootout count and sudden-death length; aggregate archetype fits.

KXWCNOEURSA.note: No rules; champion's confederation is a partition of the outright winner distribution; competition_winner_and_top_n is right.

KXWCPLAY.note: No rules; 'Play in Game' may be team-in-match (bracket composition) or a player appearance; composition reading accepted at low confidence.

KXWCPLAYERGOALS.note: No rules; likely tournament goal total of a player (like KXWCCAREERGOALS rules), a counting-stat mechanism; a per-match scorer reading remains possible.

KXWCSCOREET.note: No rules; exact score including extra time, conditional on reaching ET; still the exact-score mechanism with an ET goal process. Agree.

KXWCTEAMGOALS.note: No rules; tournament team goal total assumed (depends on matches played via advancement). Single-match reading cannot be excluded; low confidence correct.

KXWCTEAMH2H.note: No rules; two-team comparison (stage reached or goals) is the competition_head_to_head mechanism; a new archetype for one series is not warranted.

KXWCTEAMSINGAME.note: No rules; which teams meet in a specified match is a joint bracket-slot outcome; composition archetype accepted, overlaps advancement.

KXWCTEAMTOTAL.note: No rules; follows the KX*TEAMTOTAL single-match team-goal naming; total_goals includes team totals. Tournament reading not excluded, low.

KXWCTEAMTOTALGOALS.note: No rules; title 'World Cup Tournament Goals' explicitly an aggregate over all matches; tournament_aggregate_event_props is right.

KXWCTOTAL.note: No rules; matches KX<league>TOTAL naming (EPL/UCL sampled as single-match totals after 90 minutes), so total_goals per match is the best reading.

KXWCTOTALGOAL.note: No rules; KXEPLTOTAL titled 'Total Goals' is single-match per rules, so this is plausibly a match total; tournament aggregate has its own series.

KXWCTTSF.note: No rules; duplicate of team-to-score-first; first_to_score_event is the correct single-match first-goal mechanism.

KXWCWINNERTRAIL.note: No rules; whether the eventual champion trails at any point is a joint winner-path and in-match event over the tournament; aggregate archetype fits.

KXWT20WORLDCUP.note: Women's cricket T20 World Cup; unsupported sport, out of scope regardless of missing rules text.

KXITASUPERCUPADVANCE.reason: Ticker suffix ADVANCE (as in other KX*ADVANCE series) and the Supercoppa's four-team semifinal/final format indicate per-tie 'to advance' contracts settled by result incl. extra time or penalties; the 'Winner' title conflicts, so unverified.
